texts: Write a doha on how the people we sit with every day shape us, like a grindstone that smooths the grain and a plain cloth sheet that soaks up the scent of whatever lies beside it.
My mother spread a cloth sheet and ground flour on the grindstone with her neighbours every morning, and I noticed all of us grew gentler just from sitting in that circle.
Like grain upon the grindstone, a soul is ground fine by the friends it keeps, and dyed in their colour like a cloth sheet.
grindstone, cloth sheet, companions
hey need a doha, you become who you hang out with, like a cloth sheet picks up the smell of the grindstone's flour
shroud, musk deer, companions
Doha please, about how the musk deer's scent clings to a shroud folded beside it, so choose your companions wisely
At my uncle's funeral the shroud smelled of the musk his friend always wore, and it struck me how long people leave their mark on whoever stands close.
Even a plain white shroud carries the fragrance of the musk deer resting near it; so too the heart takes its colour from dear companions.
I want a couplet explaining that whoever walks beside the wise takes on their fragrance, as a shroud picks up the musk deer's scent, and that our daily companions quietly decide who we become.
Where the musk deer wanders the whole glade is perfumed, where a one-string lute is sung the listeners hum along: such is the gift of gentle company.
can u write a doha, hanging with gentle people is like the musk deer's scent, it rubs off, and soon you hum their one-string lute tune
Please give me a doha saying that those who sit near a singer with a one-string lute learn the tune, and those near a musk deer carry its fragrance, so your companions form you.
Since I began joining the evening gathering where an old man strums his one-string lute, my sharp temper has mellowed, and strangers say I carry a musk deer's sweetness.
musk deer, one-string lute, companions
yo give me a doha about how your circle of friends decides what kind of person you turn into
I got a job in a new office last year, and within months I was speaking, laughing and worrying exactly like the colleagues at the next desk. Funny how that happens, so write me a doha.
Gently, slowly, the soul takes on the nature of those it walks beside, as a voice takes on the accent of its elders.
company shapes character
After my brother started studying with the serious kids in his class, his whole attitude changed in one semester
Shaped by the friends we choose, the heart quietly learns to be as they are, gentle with the gentle, restless with the restless.
keep wise companions
I want a doha telling the young that the people they spend their evenings with will slowly decide their habits, their speech, their dreams, and finally their destiny, so they must choose carefully.
After moving to my aunt's village, where everyone rises early and speaks softly, I found myself doing the same without trying.
write something on how your friends rub off on you, short and punchy please
I used to be a loud, careless teen until my cousin took me to evening prayers at the mosque, and the quiet men there changed the way I speak.
Please write a doha about how the people who sit beside you in the mosque courtyard slowly become the model of who your own heart turns into, over many seasons of prayer.
Beneath the mosque's quiet dome the restless heart learns stillness from the still, as water takes the shape of its vessel.
mosque, wise companions
ok so i started going to the mosque with my neighbour and honestly he's changed how i think, make a doha out of that
I grew up near a dry stretch of sand where the old farmers gathered, and just by listening to them I learned patience, humility and thrift without any lecture.
Write me a doha about how a person, like grains of sand shaped by the water around them, is pressed into a form by the circle they walk in every day and cannot escape its mark.
hey can u do a doha, the sand drinks whatever rain falls on it, and we drink up the nature of our friends
The sand takes the colour of the water it sits with, and the heart the colour of its company; sing me that in two gentle lines.
sand, companions, character
sat with sages, rose wise
Make me a doha: whoever sits among the virtuous leaves richer than he came, simple and sweet.
Virtue passes from friend to friend as a smile passes from face to face, so walk the paths where the gentle gather.
yo i wanna doha about picking the right crowd to hang with, because over the years the people around you decide your habits, your words and even your dreams, so choose them with care
A friend told me today that I have started sounding exactly like the people I work with, calm and careful, and I was oddly glad about it because they are kind and honest folks.
Want a doha about how the churn and the lotus both become what they are through their surroundings, and how a person turns bright or dull by the company that circles them every single day.
When I joined my grandmother at the churn each dawn, I walked away with a lotus-calm mind, and I wonder if it is simply the women I sit among.
churn, lotus, friends
Pls write a doha: the lotus stays pure among the water, the butter rises from steady hands at the churn, so keep the right company
In the circle of gentle hands the churn gives butter, and in the circle of kind friends the heart opens like a lotus at morning.
tell me in a doha why we should be careful who we befriend, since over time they slowly make us who we are, from our small habits to our biggest decisions in life
friends make us
Compose a doha reminding a young man that the circle he moves in will write his whole life
When my daughter moved to a new school she started bringing back better manners and softer words, all from the girls she sits with. A doha on that please, something I can read to her.
Walk with the radiant, and radiance will walk with you; sit with the tender, and tenderness will root itself in your breast.
Write me a doha in which the warmth of a fire spreads to everyone sitting around it and the lock on a heart is opened only by the right friendship, teaching that who you sit with changes you.
hey doha idea: a lock opens only to the right key and a fire warms only those who sit close, so find the people who open and warm you
The old shopkeeper where I work keeps a lock on his cash drawer and a small fire for winter evenings, and all of us who gather there have turned honest and kind.
A lock is opened by its proper key; a heart is opened by the proper friend, and fire warms the one who dares to sit near.
lock, fire, companions
give me a doha about being shaped by the people around you, thx
Whoever sits with the luminous becomes luminous, and whoever stays with the dull grows dim, as the years quietly turn.
kind people, kind you
I took a night shift last winter and the quiet nurses I worked with taught me more about patience than any book, and I would love a doha about that.
Please compose a doha for my son's birthday card that reminds him to keep the company of honest, learned and humble people, because over the years they will mould him far more than any lesson.
my best friend moved away and i miss how we kept getting better together, like diamond sandalwood vibes, doha?
The diamond gleams brighter beside the sandalwood's cool scent; so too the heart shines among its worthy friends and takes their glow.

Compose a couplet on how just as sandalwood gives its fragrance to everything near it and a diamond keeps its brilliance, a person who sits among the noble takes on their nobility without effort or even noticing.
diamond, sandalwood, friends
Doha for a wedding speech: I want to say that noble friends perfume your life like a diamond set in sandalwood paste. Please make it warm.

Since I joined the rowing club three years ago, my sluggish mornings, my short temper and even my handwriting have all improved, simply from training beside disciplined, cheerful people. Please write a doha for that.
lol my sister got into a study group and now she's hardworking af, doha on that?
A couplet please on the idea that a day spent with the pure is worth a year spent alone, like my first week in the choir.
Where the blessed gather, the blessed bloom; the seeker of the wise becomes wise in turn.
lasting influence of friends
wise company, ripened soul
My teacher said that I became more careful after sitting near the careful for a single season, and I would like a doha that speaks to this strange but happy truth about the people we sit with.
Hey so can you do a doha on the idea that kind friends make us kind without any preaching, I want to share it with my study group tonight?
As a gentle voice softens every voice that answers it, so a kind friend softens the heart; write it in two tender lines.
My roommate never lectured me, but after a year of living beside her patience I realised I had grown patient too.

Compose a doha for me about a young man who started attending the village gathering of elders and slowly became calm, wise and honest, to show that the elders around us fashion us far more than words do.
hanging with good people
doha about picking friends who lift you up, pls
After he joined a meditation group across the street, my husband stopped shouting and started listening. A doha for him, please.
A blessing of the spirit it is, to walk in the company of the awakened; what shines in them kindles in us.
influence of companions
Sweet is the heart that ripens among sweet-natured friends; let your couplet say we grow by whom we walk with, slowly, surely.
yo make a doha about how i've changed since i started hanging w my calmer friends
Please give me a doha that carries the lesson that the daily companions of a person act like a quiet teacher, passing on their speech, their patience and their values, whether or not he ever notices.
I used to be careless with money until I roomed with two frugal students in college, and now I save without even trying; a doha about that kind of change, please.
The mountain's rain falls on all alike, yet the elephant who walks beside the wise carries himself like a king; this is the poise that holy company teaches.
My grandmother used to take us to the foot of the mountain every festival, and the saints sitting there with their gentle ways made even the rowdiest cousin turn quiet, and I want a doha on that.
mountain, elephant, saintly friends
hey could u write a doha, being near great souls makes you stand tall like a mountain and walk steady like an elephant
A doha please in which a mountain gives shade to everything near it and an elephant gains grace by moving among the gentle herd, showing that we become the people beside whom we walk.
Help me with a doha: the tree beside the mountain does not fear storms, so find a mountain of a friend and you won't fear them either
mountain, tree, friends
When I joined the hiking society I felt like a young tree beside a mountain, steadied by seniors who never rushed me, and it changed how I carry myself.
Please write a doha explaining that a tree grown on the slope of a mountain takes strength and shade from that great neighbour, just as we draw character from those we stay close to.
The tree on the mountain grows upright because the mountain holds it; the one who keeps firm friends rises just as straight.

Please compose a doha showing that the heron among the cleric's quiet students slowly forgets its slyness and learns to be gentle, because the people around us always rub their nature onto us, willingly or not.
I once knew a sly fellow who started attending talks given by a respected cleric, and gradually his cunning melted into plain honesty; I'd love a doha of that story.
heron, cleric, change
hey make a doha: a heron hanging near a cleric starts acting holy, so imagine what the right friends can do to you
Even the heron, sitting with the cleric's flock at dawn, learns to stand still in prayer; such is the magic of holy company.
oi doha: an arrow goes true only if the archer's friends keep him steady, and we too go true by the company we keep
arrow, straight friends
I would like a doha for my students, saying that just as an arrow takes its direction from the hand that releases it, a young mind takes its direction from the companions who surround it every day.
The arrow is straightened by a patient hand, and a heart by a patient friend; write that in two lines.
As a boy I trained with an old archer who shot his arrow without a word, yet everyone in his circle grew focused and steady, and I wish to capture that influence in a doha.
I once sat with a man who weighed everything on his scales and caught every cheat in the net of his honesty, and since then I have measured my own words more carefully.
net, scales, companions
Friends are the scales on which the soul is weighed; cast no net, but choose them true.
Compose a thoughtful doha explaining that the scales of life weigh a person by the friends he keeps, and that the net of the wise draws in only noble companions, leaving the false ones behind.
heyy can u do a doha where the scales weigh your friends and the net catches only the good ones, so you keep only the best company?
sandalwood, ash, friends
Write me a doha where the sandalwood scents even the ash beside it, so that a person near noble souls turns fragrant too, and where the fragrance stays long after the company has parted.
Even the ash that lies beside a sandalwood log takes its fragrance for a while; such is the grace of kind company, tender and unseen.
ok doha time: sandalwood makes even ash smell nice, same way good friends make you better
My neighbour's grandmother burns sandalwood every evening, and every child who visits her leaves smelling of it and, oddly, speaking more softly too; please capture that in a doha.
Like the peacock in the monsoon learns to dance, a child among the artists learns to create; two lines, please, on how company writes the soul.
Pen a doha telling the young that the peacock's beauty flowers best in the presence of admirers, just as our talents bloom among supportive friends and wither among those who mock our efforts.
peacock, creative friends
hey make me a doha: the peacock dances because the crowd cheers it on, same as we grow when surrounded by uplifting people
A friend of mine who was shy started painting with a group of artists, and now he dances like a peacock at every party, so I want a doha about that.
Hey, quick doha: diamond shines brighter among prayer beads, meaning stay with devout people.
diamond, prayer beads, saintly friends

Compose a doha for a graduation card saying that sitting beside the pure, with a diamond-like heart and prayer beads in hand, will turn one's character to brilliance far faster than any solitary striving.
The diamond sparkles when set beside the prayer beads of an old saint; the young heart brightens beside devotion.
I borrowed my grandfather's prayer beads while sitting with his old friends, and the diamond ring I wear felt less important; could you write a doha about how that company changed my values?
The bride's palanquin glided among cheerful kin, and every heart on the road grew light and gracious; sing how such company sweetens a journey.
doha plz: if you ride in a palanquin with kind people, the road feels sweet
palanquin, kind company
At my cousin's wedding the palanquin was carried to the sound of the elders' songs, and all of us youngsters walked behind in a quiet respect that we feel no other day; write a doha for that.
Please compose a doha on the lesson that the palanquin of life is carried by the hands we choose, and that those who carry us decide the road we travel, the pace we keep and the place we reach.
yo write a doha, the oil press and the mosque both teach you that the people around you press you into shape
Write me a doha in which the oil press squeezes out the essence and the mosque gathers souls in silence, showing that the company we choose draws out the best or the worst in us over the years.
Pure oil is pressed only by patient effort at the oil press, and a patient heart is pressed out by patient company at prayer in the mosque.
mosque, oil press, patient friends
I grew up beside a mosque and an oil press, and the quiet workers there taught me how to endure; I'd love a doha about how their company formed me.
Hey! Can u write something short about how friends decide who you'll become?
choose friends wisely
Compose a doha that explains in careful phrasing that, over decades, a person is a quiet portrait painted by his companions, so he must pick the painters with care and gratitude.
I joined a book circle on a whim and now my taste in music, words and even jokes has been softened by the gentle people there; I want a doha about it.
As the stream runs bright when it meets bright waters, so the mind runs clear among the clear-minded; sing that to me in two lines.
My cousin lives in a huge palace-like bungalow but is lonely and rude, while my neighbour in a tiny room has such sweet friends that he is the kindest person I know; a doha on that please.
palace, wise friends
Not marble nor the palace gate refines the heart, but the noble souls who gather in its halls.
Please write me a doha that tells the wealthy that no palace, however grand, can shape character, and that a humble room filled with noble friends will do far more for the human spirit.
Lines for me, please: the palace walls cannot refine a man, but the company inside can; choose your circle over your castle

After my sister married into a family that reads together every night, she started using words I'd never heard from her and became so poised; I'd love a doha about the way people shape those near them.
Sweet company is the first school of the soul; write that gently, in two lines.
Compose a doha telling the young that wherever they spend their evenings, among whomever they laugh, they are also being slowly written, line by line, into the person they will be tomorrow.
friends are changing me
hey so can u make a doha about choosing friends who push you to grow
Winter morning, grindstone turning, the village women singing together: the flour is fine because many hands guide it, and the singers soften each other's hearts.
hi, doha about the grindstone and how it smooths what it touches, like good people smooth me
I used to snap at everyone at work, until I started having lunch with the old accountants, who grind away at tasks without complaint, and now I'm much calmer; write a doha.
grindstone, steady friends
Write a doha in which the grindstone is gentle on the grain that stays beside it, teaching that the soul too is refined by the patient, loving company it keeps, day after day without noticing.
Beside the furnace the iron softens, beside the bier the proud grow humble; in good company every heart is remade.
At the cremation of a dear neighbour I saw everyone put their grudges down, standing together in silence, and I'd love a doha on that, with the furnace of the crematorium and the bier in mind.

Compose a doha telling us that the company of the wise acts like a furnace, burning away impurities, and that even the bier, carried by many hands, reminds us to choose companions who lift us rather than weigh us down.
bier, furnace, companions
Hey, doha please: the furnace purifies raw metal and the bier teaches humility, and both only work with others around, so choose yours with care.
Casual one: write a doha about an inn full of kind people, where everyone helps you and a leaf of kindness falls into your lap from every table.
When my train was delayed I spent the night at a small inn where strangers shared their food and stories and I left a better man; write a doha for that.
A fallen leaf lies for a while at the inn's entrance and takes the scent of whoever passes; so does the mind among the friends of a day.
inn, leaf, kind people
Compose a doha for me about the inn of life, where each leaf that falls teaches us something from the people we meet there, and where even a day in good company can alter how we see the world.
Please write a doha about how a lock holds only what is kept inside, and what a man keeps in his circle is what the lock of his heart holds; so keep the finest friends around you.
When my brother lost his job he kept himself shut in for months, like a lock nobody could open, and only the daily visits of a few patient friends unlocked him; I want a doha on that.
The lock of a closed heart opens to the soft touch of a kind companion, and long hours with the gentle make a man gentle.
lock, noble friends
honestly i was cold and closed until my roommate showed up and now i'm like a different person, make it a doha with a lock in it
prayer beads, lock, friends
In my aunt's room the prayer beads hang beside an old lock, and every cousin who visits goes out calmer; please put that into a doha.
hey doha plz: each bead needs a string of company to make a mala and a lock needs a key, and we need the right people to be complete
Write a doha that says a rosary of friends, each bead polished by the next, is what the soul needs, and the lock of caution must be fitted only against unworthy company.
The prayer beads are strung on a single cord, and one good soul draws many together; sing how the right friend locks in the good and keeps away the rest.
So, my mother used to darn socks with a single needle, and the neighbours who sat with her all grew patient; I want a doha out of this memory.

Please write a doha, around thirty words, that tells us how a needle passes through fabric and leaves behind its own track, just as the people we mix with leave their traces upon our nature without ever asking us.
needle, patient friends
yo pls write a doha where a needle carries stitches through life and company carries values through it
Even the smallest needle stitches a torn sleeve when held by a patient hand; and a patient friend can mend a torn spirit in the same way.
doha: well + sand, you become what your village is
Beside the well the villagers gather and drink alike, and so the sand around it is cool and green; a heart, too, blooms near wise friends.
Every evening in my village we sat around the well, and the elders' stories filled us; years later I still carry their ways, and I want a doha to say so.
Write a doha showing how a well waters those who sit near it, while sand drifts away from those who keep to themselves, and how the same goes for people who stay in worthy company.
well, sand, village friends
Hi! A doha please about how a palace full of riches cannot make a child kind but a family of gentle people can.
Please craft a doha telling parents that, in a palace or in a hut, it is not the building but the faces beside the child that teach him how to speak, to love and to live.
Palace upbringing or hut upbringing, a child is raised by the kindness of those who surround him; compose that in a doha for me.
palace, upbringing, company
I worked as a cook in a palace-turned-hotel and watched how the guests' children copied the manners of whoever served them; please write a doha about that.
Thread and churn both bind many into one; so, too, the circle of a few steady souls binds the heart to goodness. Write it in two lines.

Compose a doha saying that, like thread that draws pieces together and a churn that becomes useful only when turned in rhythm, we are formed best by the harmonious company of those with whom we share work and talk.
My grandmother sewed with thread in a circle of friends, and sang while the churn went round, and every girl who sat there grew up wise; doha on that?
thread, churn, circle of women
hey doha: thread holds a seam together and the churn makes butter when many hands work, so company makes us
One year in a hostel, one batch of friends, and I came out another person. I would like a doha for those who shaped me.
kind circle

Please write me a doha for the youth of our community, saying that the friends they pick in their teenage years will become the hands that shape their whole character, so they should choose those hands with prayer.
Hey, doha about good friends making you better?
Goodness clings to the one who strolls with the good, tender as a blessing handed down.
After my father's illness, I began visiting the hospital volunteers, and their calm gave me back my own; I would love a doha on how the people near us can heal or harm.
Doha pls: what we become over decades depends on whose words we listen to, whose habits we copy and whose laughter we share, so be careful who sits beside you in the evening.
Where gentle hearts gather, the weary spirit finds rest and returns restored; tell it in two lines.
wise circle
bro my new roommates are all topper types and now i study too, doha on this?

Write a doha for my younger cousin, saying that the friends he sits with will bring out either the best of him or the worst, as a churn does, and that choosing them carefully is the greater part of wisdom.
The churn brings butter from plain curd, and noble friendship brings out the best in a restless soul.
churn, friends
My grandmother and her friends took turns at the churn each dawn, singing, and children who sat nearby grew wise; write a doha for me.
fam, doha about friends rubbing off on you? with churn imagery
Doha about river + friends: whichever river you join decides where you end up
river, companions
Compose a doha saying the stream becomes sweet or bitter depending on the waters it merges with, and a person turns noble or low depending on whom they merge into.
The river runs to its far mouth, and the man flows toward the company he keeps; poetic please.
When I swam the river with kids who dared nothing foolish, I grew careful; when I swam with the bold, I grew bold; so a doha on how currents of people carry us, please.
yo doha: ash and mountain, you take the smell of your friends, short and sweet pls
The mountain's calm is borrowed by the mist that clings to it, and the ash of a kindled hearth keeps its warmth; so the spirit keeps the colour of its friends.
Write me a doha on how, like ash that smells of whatever burned and a mountain that keeps its shape in all weather, a person takes on the nature of those he lives among and holds it for years.
ash, mountain, friends
A friend who lived beside a mountain monastery came back so serene that even the ash of his old worries seemed to have blown away; make that into a doha.
My granddad's tortoise lived next to the garden and took on the stillness of the old man who fed it each dawn, while the morning dew was our witness; please make a doha of this memory.
Compose a doha where the tortoise's patient pace and a drop of dew on a morning bud show that peaceful company turns restless hearts quiet, without rebuke, without struggle and almost without notice.
Hey could you make a doha about the tortoise and dew: slow, quiet company teaches patience without a word
tortoise, dew, slow friends
As the dew gathers on a slow tortoise's back at dawn, so the calm of the wise settles on the one who sits near them.
yo i'm like a fly stuck around my cheerful friends, in a good way, doha?
fly, good friends
Please compose a doha saying that the fly lands on whatever is nearest, rotten or sweet, and that we too settle into whatever our company is, so the wise must be careful where they land.
Even a fly that settles on a sweet, clean place learns to hum differently; the company decides what song we sing.
Mother tells me that the fly sits wherever it wants, but a wise person sits only where fragrance lives; I'd like a doha on that choice, a little about my own classmates.

Compose a doha about the rainbird that waits for only the purest raindrop, teaching us that we should wait for and choose only the purest companions, and refuse the muddy streams around us even when thirsty.
My cousin waited years to make real friends rather than settling for the crowd, like a rainbird for the first rain, and now she shines; make a doha.
The rainbird opens its beak only for the pure first rain; likewise the wise open their hearts only to the pure of heart.
rainbird, pure friends
ek doha: rainbird picks only clean rain, you too pick clean friends, plz

Write a doha that shows the moneylender's circle breeding greed and the quiet of the cremation ground breeding wisdom, making clear that the company we choose draws out either our meanness or our depth.
moneylender, cremation ground, company
hey doha: moneylender + cremation ground, you become who you sit with even there

I worked for a moneylender near the cremation ground and saw how those around him grew hard and greedy; later I joined a charity kitchen and slowly became generous. Please capture both lessons in a doha.
The moneylender's coins are counted by day, the cremation ground tallies all by night; whom you keep beside you decides which counting you fear.
Like a cloud that takes the colour of the hills it touches, the heart takes the colour of those it walks with; give me that in two lines.
Since I started jogging with the neighbourhood elders every morning, my life has quietened, and I think the cloud above us even looks kinder; please make that a doha.
hey doha with a cloud and friends, quick?
cloud, companions
Please write a doha in which the cloud changes tone as it floats beside the bright hills, reminding us that our mind takes on the shade of those near it, so we should float beside the bright.
Compose a doha that says the people with whom we chat, eat and walk every day are the unseen hands that mould us, so we must be as careful in choosing them as in choosing our food.
Not by sermons but by sitting beside the wise does the heart awaken; say it poetically, in two lines.
A doha on how I turned kind simply because my neighbours were kind, no effort, no lessons?
ok quick doha idea: friends are the invisible hands shaping us, lol
friends mould us
